summary: Comprehensive test suite spanning unit and integration levels. Workflow.Tests.ps1 validates YAML structure, actionlint compliance, and performs three end-to-end act pipeline runs with exact output assertions. DependencyLicenseChecker.Tests.ps1 provides thorough unit coverage using Pester mocks for the license lookup seam, tests both npm and pip manifest parsing with error handling, and verifies all classification logic. Strengths: deterministic text output validation, mocking strategy, multiple manifest formats, workflow job structure verification. Minor gaps: CLI parameter combinations (markdown/json formats, FailOnViolation flag) not directly tested through act; act integration setup is monolithic (all three cases run in BeforeAll, making failure diagnosis harder); fixture files (caseB-package.json, caseC-requirements.txt) referenced but not shown. Would reliably catch regressions in core functionality and workflow execution.
